positions.title: Vice President of Product
positions.description:
I lead a global team of world-class Product Managers, UX Researchers, Product Analysts and Product Designers. We deliver value to users across our digital experiences by solving real user problems in cross-functional, empowered teams. We believe in continous product improvements inspired by customer centricity and enabled through an egoless environment and data obsession. Powered by our platforms we launch new live experiments every day in order to test hypotheses and solutions to learn and fail fast. 

Making dinner a delicious achievement - not just another meal - takes a lot of work and smart people. Our tech teams located in Berlin, New York, Boulder, and Toronto, are critical to our business success. From building experiences for loyal customers to conversion rate optimization and upselling features, we work on a wide variety of domains and challenges measured by real financial impact.

As the global leader in the meal kit space, HelloFresh operates in 14 markets and delivers > 500 million meals a year. Our meal kits include easy-to-follow full recipes made from fresh, responsibly sourced ingredients and not only take the hassle out of making dinner, but change the way people eat - forever. We are at the forefront of disrupting a multi-trillion dollar industry at the very beginning of its online transition. 

See current openings on our careers page and check out our tech blog to get an insight into who our tech team is and some of the special projects they work on.

company.name: HelloFresh
company.tagline: We change the way people eat - forever.
company.description:
HelloFresh is on a mission to change the way people eat, forever!

From our 2011 founding in Europe’s vibrant tech hub Berlin, we’re evolving from the world’s leading meal kit company to the world's leading food solutions group. We delivered 243.3 million meals and reached 7.5 million active customers around the world in Q3 2022. 

HelloFresh Group consists of six brands that provide customers with high quality food and recipes for different meal occasions. Every ingredient needed for our meals are carefully planned, responsibly sourced and delivered to your door when it’s most convenient for you. Only HelloFresh gives you the tools to achieve something delicious every day.

Making a meal a delicious achievement - not just fuel for your day - takes a lot of work and smart people. From Designers and Copywriters to Data Scientists and DevOps Engineers, to potato farmers, pasta makers and the people who ensure every box is perfectly packed for every customer, we’re collectively disrupting the food supply chain and the multi-trillion-dollar food tech industry.

Our more than 21,000 high-performing and ambitious employees across the globe from New York to Berlin, London to Sydney and Toronto to Milan enjoy a number of benefits including flexible working arrangements, discounts on our boxes, health and well-being and learning and development programs.

We’re always looking for quality ingredients to perfect our recipe, so join us now!  https://www.hellofresh.com/careers/locations
